hook: Morning *fog* behind bus crash on NH-65 near RC Puram
hook_b: Morning *fog* behind bus crash on NH-65 near RC Puram
tldr: The private travel bus turned turtle on Wednesday morning; the bus driver was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

beats.what: A speeding lorry hit the bus from behind after the bus driver reportedly braked suddenly.
beats.why: Fog had covered the area, so the lorry driver could not see the bus braking.
beats.care: Fog season is starting on highways around Hyderabad; morning commuters on NH-65 should slow down.

fact: A private bus overturned on *NH-65* near RC Puram after a lorry hit it.
twist: Police say *morning fog* hid the bus's sudden braking from the lorry driver behind it.
